## English

Traditions and History of Japan That Even Adults Get Wrong: a reference database of 95 items about common misconceptions on Japanese tradition and history, each with sources, a confidence mark (Confirmed / Needs checking / Not confirmable), caveats and a last-checked date. English text is a machine translation (by Claude) of the Japanese original and is in the en object of each item in data.json. Add ?lang=en to the page URL for the English view.
